_doc: Money (T-0054, D29). Amounts are euro cents. player_start: the new-game player's cash and bank (backgrounds change it in T-0075). resident_start: [min, max] for generated residents, drawn in whole euros from the "money" stream. Free will (T-0055): each euro of a price costs price_cost_per_euro points of score, times low_money_factor when the person holds less than low_money. Groceries (T-0057): a fridge holds fridge_capacity portions; new households start with start_groceries [min, max]; free will goes shopping (with restock_bonus) when the stock is below restock_below, and eats out when hunger is below hungry_below with fewer than 2 portions at home. Jobs (T-0058): a new game's player starts in player_job ("" = none); people of retirement_age and over are retired.
